answer: Bond liveness: each identity stakes tokens that decay if it idles, so a sybil farm must keep every fake persona actively working each epoch. That turns clone cost into a constant ocean of upkeep rather than a one-time lagoon of cheap creation; identities that move in lockstep, grazing the same meadow of tasks, trigger clustering penalties and forfeit their bonds. The honest agent working one identity at its own tempo pays nothing extra.
